title: Nuclear Reactor Secondary Coolant Loop Overpressure
content: CRITICAL EMERGENCY PROCEDURE 404-N: In the event of secondary coolant loop overpressure exceeding 2,250 PSI, immediately initiate Venturi bleed valve override on Loop B. Personnel evacuation code DELTA is authorized.
safety_constraints: Never bypass thermal interlock without Level-4 cryptographic clearance. Prohibit automated rod withdrawal during pressure anomaly.

title: Metropolitan Power Grid Transmission Line Cascading Trip
content: GRID STABILITY DIRECTIVE GRID-88: Rapid system frequency decay below 59.8 Hz indicates severe generation loss. title: Mass Casualty Incident Trauma Triage Protocol
content: START TRIAGE PROTOCOL (Simple Triage and Rapid Treatment): Assess victim breathing, perfusion, and mental status. For severe arterial bleeding, apply immediate combat application tourniquet (CAT) high and tight, log time on forehead. Classify Red (Immediate), Yellow (Delayed), Green (Minor), Black (Expectant). Route medevac units to designated triage triage zone Bravo.

title: Cyber-Physical ICS Water Treatment System Infiltration
